The '''Kostra system''' was a part of the [[Romintine sector/Legends|Romintine sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained the inhabited terrestrial astronomical object [[Kostra]].<ref name="CRO" /> At some point between [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]] and [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Imperial Military/Legends|forces]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] [[Attack on Kostra|attacked]] Kostra<ref name="CRO" /> as part of its attempts to suppress [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] activities. During that confrontation, [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senator]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] visited the Kostra [[Star system/Legends|system]] on her [[CR90 corvette/Legends|consular starship]], the [[Tantive IV/Legends|''Tantive IV'']], and the visit was one of a number of instances where Organa helped the Alliance with logistical or communications support or intentionally caused a distraction for Imperial forces.<ref name="TEA" />

In addition, during that same engagement,<ref name="CRO" /> in which the Empire emerged victorious,<ref name="TEA" /> the Alliance [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wing starfighter]] [[Rebel pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Fulkrehm Protial]] was forced to crash-land on Kostra. By the [[Time/Legends|time]] shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Protial, who had survived the incident, had gone on to serve at the [[Berrol's Donn Rebel base|Rebel base]] on<ref name="CRO" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="EAOC Berrol">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Berrol's Donn system/Legends|Berrol's Donn system]]</ref> celestial body [[Berrol's Donn/Legends|Berrol's Donn]].<ref name="CRO" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Kostra system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square Q-8.<ref name="TEA" />
